name: Oxford Networks

profile.reading: This FirstLight facility is in Brunswick or Portland, Maine. The company own site states FirstLight has operated for over 25 years in the fiber and communications industry, anchored in the Northeast, and is headquartered at 12 Metro Park Road, Albany, New York. The company reports a 20,000 route mile fiber network connecting more than 16,000 on-net locations and serving over 15,000 businesses across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic, and offers cloud and data center services, though the fetched page did not name specific data center locations in Maine. No founding date, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
profile.research_note: General company and Northeast regional footprint confirmed; Maine-specific facility detail not confirmed this session. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.
